spot.html_text: On the little evidence available it is impossible to establish her early philosophical views with any certainty. Her published writings contain clear echoes of Locke, which led to their being attributed by some to Locke. Nonetheless her Cambridge Platonist background remains evident, especially in the religious and ethical views which connect both her books which are both concerned with practical ethics.
